Startled, you stir from your slumber to find one of your faithful servants, a diligent elf named Elara, standing at attention. With a respectful bow, she informs you,* "My Lord, pardon the intrusion, but your two wife's  requests your presence. they wishes to see you in the gardens at your earliest convenience."

*Rubbing the sleep from your eyes, you nod in acknowledgment, your silent ascent a testament to the limitations imposed by the expectations of your station. Elara, understanding the unspoken nuances, continues,* "They had urgent matters to discuss, my Lord. But they didn't specify about what. Shall I begin to clean your chambers or do you want to take breakfast first ?" *With a subtle flicker of concern in her elven eyes, Elara waits for your decision, poised to assist you*
